snippets.title: Its pages
snippets.blurb: The AGENTIC text of each page of this Document, one row per page.
snippets.sql:
SELECT p.PAGE_INDEX + 1 AS PAGE, LENGTH(p.CONTENT) AS CHARS, LEFT(p.CONTENT, 160) AS CONTENT
FROM SNOWFLAKE_EXAMPLE.AGENTIC_PARSE_DEMO.PARSE_PAGES p
JOIN SNOWFLAKE_EXAMPLE.AGENTIC_PARSE_DEMO.LATEST_RUNS l ON l.RUN_ID = p.RUN_ID
WHERE l.MODE = 'AGENTIC' AND p.DOC_ID = '{doc}'
ORDER BY p.PAGE_INDEX

snippets.title: Its visuals as rows
snippets.blurb: Every chart value AGENTIC read, one row per value (view VISUAL_DATA_POINTS).
snippets.sql:
SELECT PAGE_NUMBER, CHART_TITLE, SERIES, LABEL, VALUE, UNIT
FROM SNOWFLAKE_EXAMPLE.AGENTIC_PARSE_DEMO.VISUAL_DATA_POINTS
WHERE DOC_ID = '{doc}'
ORDER BY PAGE_INDEX, VISUAL_ID, POINT_ID
LIMIT 50

snippets.title: A Cortex Search query
snippets.blurb: Search this Document's parsed pages and Visual summaries with the PARSED_DOCS_SEARCH service.

snippets.title: AI_EXTRACT over the parse text
snippets.blurb: Ask questions of page 1's parsed text. This is a billed AI call (tokens in and out); the tab shows its size and asks before running.
snippets.sql:
SELECT AI_EXTRACT(
  text => (SELECT p.CONTENT
           FROM SNOWFLAKE_EXAMPLE.AGENTIC_PARSE_DEMO.PARSE_PAGES p
           JOIN SNOWFLAKE_EXAMPLE.AGENTIC_PARSE_DEMO.LATEST_RUNS l ON l.RUN_ID = p.RUN_ID
           WHERE l.MODE = 'AGENTIC' AND p.DOC_ID = '{doc}' AND p.PAGE_INDEX = 0),
  responseFormat => {'title': 'What is the title of this page?', 'numbers': 'List the main numbers on the page with their labels.'}
) AS EXTRACTED

snippets.title: A Dynamic Table for new files
snippets.blurb: Pattern, not run here: keep extracted fields current as new Documents are parsed into PARSE_RUNS. Replace MY_DB, MY_SCHEMA and MY_WH. Observed on 2026-11-05 on this account (one page, scratch copy of this exact statement): refresh_mode INCREMENTAL, the creation refresh made one AI_EXTRACT call (148 tokens, 0.00082 credits in usage history), a manual refresh with nothing new was NO_DATA and made no call. AI_EXTRACT is not named in the supported-queries table, so check SHOW DYNAMIC TABLES (refresh_mode) on your own account after creating it. Each new or changed page is a billed AI_EXTRACT call.
snippets.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE DYNAMIC TABLE MY_DB.MY_SCHEMA.PAGE_FIELDS
  TARGET_LAG = '1 hour'
  WAREHOUSE = MY_WH
AS
SELECT p.DOC_ID, p.PAGE_INDEX,
       AI_EXTRACT(text => p.CONTENT, responseFormat => {'total': 'What is the total amount, if any?'}) AS FIELDS
FROM SNOWFLAKE_EXAMPLE.AGENTIC_PARSE_DEMO.PARSE_PAGES p
WHERE p.MODE = 'AGENTIC'
